facts.fact: Gina 辅导约会成功——能听她讲喜欢的题目听几小时
facts.anchor: I could sit and listen to her talk about her favourite topics

facts.fact: 她对 Bailey 直接用了 autism 一词（关心 specialist subjects）
facts.anchor: having someone care about your specialist subjects when you have autism

facts.fact: 秘密观赛：不许告诉 Max——「我叫他 Max 是为了逗他」
facts.anchor: I call him Max because it winds him up.

facts.fact: 流浪猫真身是有主的走失猫；Max 童年专抓邻居家猫送回家、一路臭脸
facts.anchor: he’d scoop them up and take them home, all grumpy.

facts.fact: Bailey 的记忆：「那时我们笑得很多」——多待在 Max 身边帮他想起来
facts.anchor: we laughed a lot. Being around him more helps me remember.

facts.fact: 「我曾盼他来把我从 Ted 身边带走」
facts.anchor: I used to wish he’d come and take me away from Ted.

facts.fact: Flora 立誓：Els 父母两周后回来；不点头就她自己说
facts.anchor: then I’ll bloody do it myself.

facts.fact: Max 被摔进挡板后大笑不打架——「他也许不是别人说的那种人」
facts.anchor: Maybe he’s not the person other people say he is.
